key_findings.positive_imbalance: 75.77% of training positives are straightforward high-similarity matches. The 24.23% hard positives (cross-script, numeric conflict, asymmetric overlap) receive equal weight and are overwhelmed by easier positive gradients.
key_findings.negative_hardness: 50.8% of training negatives already have high name or address similarity (hard negatives). However, Formula 2 retrieves even harder candidates into Cap-200 on validation.
